description:
pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:139-146

The de_static_str serde helper leaks one heap allocation per unique deserialized string:

  pub(crate) fn de_static_str<'de, D>(deserializer: D) -> Result<&'static str, D::Error>
  ...
      Ok(Box::leak(s.into_boxed_str()))

The code comment documents this correctly and identifies the v0.3 migration path (Cow<'static, str>). However, there is no Beads issue tracking the v0.3 work. If this crate is ever used in a long-running service that deserializes findings from a database or message queue, memory will grow without bound.

This is not a bug in the current usage (short-lived processes), but it needs a tracked v0.3 issue so it isn't forgotten.

Suggested fix (v0.3): migrate LintResult::Warn/Error/Fatal detail fields from &'static str to Cow<'static, str>, which eliminates the leak and the serde bound(deserialize='de: 'static) constraint.
title: [rusty] pkix-path: de_static_str leaks memory — tracked for v0.3 but not filed as issue
